name: AI platform — gateway, routing, prompts & evals, guardrails, embeddings, fairness, BYO key

epics.name: AI gateway, metering & budgets
epics.goal: One entry point for every model call with a fixed check order, a ledger that records every attempt, materialised period spend, per-feature daily caps and pluggable budget resolution (plan, admin override, org grant).

epics.name: Model routing & providers
epics.goal: A second provider (Claude Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5) behind the same seam, a runtime routing table by task and budget position, provider-neutral structured outputs, fallback and circuit breaker, pricing on settings.

epics.name: Prompt registry & evals
epics.goal: Prompts as versioned code records, golden datasets per task, an eval harness with deterministic checks plus an LLM judge, a CI gate on prompt/route changes and a nightly drift monitor.

epics.name: Guardrails & truth checks
epics.goal: A shared truth-check library (numbers, entities, dates, relations), an Untrusted input type, an output validator in the gateway, provenance on every change, content policy and a report-this-answer loop.

epics.name: Embeddings & retrieval for matching
epics.goal: Posting and profile embeddings in MySQL, a two-stage retrieval pipeline that replaces word-overlap prefiltering, feedback learning, semantic dedup, synonym-aware keyword coverage and hybrid search.

epics.name: Fairness, explainability & AI transparency
epics.goal: A proven allowlist that keeps protected data out of prompts, scores that always carry evidence, bias evals in the harness, a public /ai page with per-feature switches and an audit export.

epics.name: BYO key & extension AI parity
epics.goal: The Free tier's AI: two BYO providers on current models, a shared prompt bundle, truth checks ported to the extension, a local meter and honest copy — the same quality paying users get.

epics.name: Caching, batching & cost optimisation
epics.goal: Answer cache v2 with TTL and invalidation, provider context caching on the stable prefix, Batch API for nightly work, token-based input caps and per-feature unit economics.

epics.name: AI observability & operations
epics.goal: Latency/error metrics per task and provider, provider health and status, alert rules wired to A4, an eval drift monitor and in-gateway cost anomaly guards.

epics.name: Feature kits for product areas
epics.goal: The platform pieces other areas' AI stories depend on: function calling and streaming in the seam, interview, cover-letter, rewrite and translation engines, inbox classification v2, sponsorship and interview-date extraction, ghosting timelines and Autopilot ask-and-remember.

ac: Rules registered in AiAlertEvaluator with severities from the designs; dedup per day; digest/immediate per A4.4

stories.title: Eval drift monitor: nightly live sample per task on the production route vs baseline
stories.story: As the team I want to notice a silent provider model update that changes output quality.
ac: Scheduled run after the rollup; 20 % of cases; writes eval_run rows; alert on drop > 5

stories.title: In-gateway cost anomaly guard: refuse a call whose cost would exceed 5× the task's 30-day p95; hard output caps
stories.story: As the platform I want a runaway prompt caught at the call, not on the invoice.
ac: p95 per task cached from the rollup; estimated cost > 5× → AI_INPUT_TOO_LARGE + alert
maxOutputTokens per task enforced from the routing table

stories.title: Function calling in the seam: generateWithTools on Gemini (functionDeclarations) and Anthropic (tools, auto choice); typed AiTool registry contract; loop bound
stories.story: As the assistant (U8.1) I want tool calls from either provider in one shape so that the agent loop is provider-agnostic.
ac: AiCall.tools + AiResult.toolCalls[] normalised; forced tool choice never used (rejected on Claude 5.5)
ToolRegistry contract: typed args, user-scoped execution, untrusted wrapper on results, write tools require confirm
Loop helper ≤ 4 rounds, output ≤ 700 tokens, metered as ASSISTANT
tests: Provider tool-call parsing tests both providers; AgentLoopTest bound + confirm gating

stories.title: Interview practice engine: rubric-scored feedback (STAR coverage, specificity, length, relevance), session summary, ≤ $0.05/session
stories.story: As a Pro user practising for Thursday I want feedback that cites my own answer and never promises an outcome.
stories.genz: Reps with receipts, included in Pro.
ac: Tasks INTERVIEW_TURN / INTERVIEW_SUMMARY; prompts interview.turn/summary; Sonnet 5.5 → Haiku by budget tier
Feedback JSON {dims{star,specific,length,relevance}:1–5, cites[], suggestion}; truth profile INTERVIEW; no promises
Daily cap setting `ai.cap.interview.daily` (default 3 sessions); cost assert ≤ $0.05 at 6 turns
tests: InterviewEngineTest fake provider; eval interview.turn; cost test
stories.benchmark: Final Round AI charges $90–149/mo and is rated on mock quality; live copilots are a reputational risk we avoid (G27).

stories.title: Cover-letter engine (COVER): tone modes, sentence-level truth flags, sources, ≤ $0.02/letter
stories.story: As the Resume Builder (R5.3) I want a cover-letter service that returns flagged, sourced text so that the editor can show what to check.
ac: Task COVER, prompt cover.letter, schema {paragraphs[{text, sources[]}]}; truth profile COVER; apply refused while [check] remains
Cached per (doc hash × JD hash × tone)

stories.title: Resume rewrite/summary engine (REWRITE modes, SUMMARY tones) with proposals, 2–3 alternatives per bullet, reasons
stories.story: As the Resume Builder (R4.*) I want one ResumeAiService that returns checked proposals so that its five AI stories are UI work.
ac: Tasks REWRITE (modes shorten/formal/plain/grammar) and SUMMARY (concise/confident/plain); refs e/p/summary; ≤ 12 refs × 3 alternatives
Every change has reason ≤ 160 chars + sources[]; placeholder [add a number] allowed only as literal
Cached per (task × mode × docHash × refs × jdHash)
tests: ResumeAiServiceTest fake provider; eval rewrite set
stories.benchmark: Teal/Rezi complaint: rewrites are generic; ours are diffs with reasons and sources.

stories.title: Translation task (TRANSLATE) producing a new resume with a back-translation consistency check
stories.story: As a bilingual user I want a translated copy that kept every number and employer.
ac: Whole-doc translate → new resume kind BUILT meta.language; numbers/entities truth check against the source
Back-translation sample (3 bullets) compared with cosine ≥ 0.8 or flagged

stories.title: Streaming in the seam (Gemini streamGenerateContent / Anthropic stream) → Flux<AiEvent> for the assistant and interview
stories.story: As a chat user I want the first token in under 2 s so that the assistant feels like a DM.
stories.genz: Fast first token or it feels broken.
ac: callStreaming runs gateway steps 1–10 first, streams delta/tool/done, finalises steps 12–14 on completion with full usage
Disconnect → server completes and persists
tests: Streaming provider tests; gateway streaming IT frame order

stories.title: Inbox classification v2: confidence threshold → Needs-review, eval set of 50 mails, economy routing, marketer budget attribution
stories.story: As a user I want ambiguous job mail to land in a review list rather than flip my board wrong.
ac: INBOX schema adds confidence; < 0.7 → suggestion not auto-status
Eval inbox.classify ≥ 0.9 category accuracy; InboxParser calls the gateway

stories.title: Sponsorship / work-authorisation signal on postings (G13): rules first, economy model when ambiguous, labelled fixture recall ≥ 0.9
stories.story: As an international student I want cards to say 'sponsors' or 'no sponsorship' so that I stop reading jobs I cannot take.
stories.genz: The filter that saves an hour a day.
ac: job_posting.sponsorship OFFERED|NOT_OFFERED|UNKNOWN from the rule list in the embeddings design §7; ambiguous → nightly ENRICH batch on the platform budget
300-posting labelled fixture; NOT_OFFERED recall ≥ 0.9
Match rule (needs sponsorship × NOT_OFFERED → < 30) and card tag; U4.5 preference filter reads it
stories.benchmark: G13 — Jobright's H-1B filter is its wedge with international students.

stories.title: Interview date/time extraction from job mail (G19): deterministic parsers first, AI only when ambiguous on the user's budget → proposed interview row
stories.story: As a user I want an interview invite in my inbox to become a proposed interview I confirm in one tap.
stories.genz: Calendar done for you, with a confirm.
ac: Parsers for common ATS/calendar invite phrasing (date, time, tz, video link, location) over headers + body text only (never attachments)
Ambiguous → INBOX_EXTRACT task with schema {start, end, tz, mode, link}; confidence < 0.8 → 'check the time'
Proposed interview row (U6.4 schema) with source mail id; user confirms; .ics follows
stories.benchmark: G19 — no competitor has the inbox.

stories.title: Expected-response timeline + GHOSTED suggestion (G16): per-ATS/company median reply days from inbox events (statistics, no LLM)
stories.story: As a user I want to know 'most Greenhouse companies replied within 12 days' and get a one-tap 'mark as ghosted / follow up' after that.
stories.genz: Closure, with data.
ac: Nightly stat: median/p75 days-to-first-reply by ATS and by company (k ≥ 5, else ATS-level) from application events + inbox classifications
Applications past p75 with no event → GHOSTED suggestion; one tap sets status or schedules U6.8 follow-up
Timeline shown on the application detail; no model call
stories.benchmark: G16 — 48–53 % of applications go unanswered (Criteria); nobody shows expected timelines.

stories.title: JD-driven interview question set (G26): deterministic bank tags from posting skills (Free), Pro adds generated role-specific questions grounded in the JD
stories.story: As a user with an interview on the board I want 'Prep for this' to open questions about this job's skills, not generic ones.
stories.genz: Prep for Thursday, not for 'a job'.
ac: Free: bank questions tagged by posting skills/role (no AI)
Pro: task QUESTIONS_GENERATE with the JD as Untrusted → ≤ 8 questions each citing a JD phrase; cached per posting
Hand-off from the application detail (U9.4)
stories.benchmark: G26 — Big Interview banks by role; Final Round mocks; neither is grounded in the actual posting.

stories.title: Autopilot ask-and-remember (G8): unknown required question → ask once in the drawer → learned answer reused across the run and synced
stories.story: As an Autopilot user I want to answer a new question once and have every later application in the run pre-answered so that review is fast.
stories.genz: Answer once; it remembers.
ac: NEEDS_YOU reason unknown_question shows the question in the drawer; free-text offers 'Draft with Kiwiply' (server, Pro) via JAF.ai with flags/sources
Answer stored as a learned answer (provenance autopilot) and in a run-scoped map keyed by normalised question; identical later questions pre-answered without an AI call
Never fills attestation/consent/certification boxes (19.2 rule) — test list
tests: Extension run-map test; NoAttestationFillTest; API learned-answer provenance test
stories.tech: job-autofill src/lib/ai.js questionKey, autopilot orchestrator (E area), field_cache provenance
stories.benchmark: G8 — Simplify Autopilot roadmap 'will pause and ask, and save your answers'.
